messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Ideogram
parts:
Hi,

Creating ideogram following the Altuna's blog post is not straight forward. Because, the script in the blog used earlier versions of ggplot and ggbio. Now some commands have been deprecated and do not work if called.

Primarily, the error arised because of the 'opt' which has been deprecated. You may try replacing "opts" with "labs". One may have to use ggplot2 commands. The script you have posted in the mail calls a function ideoDMC(). You may refer to the arguments in the function to avoid error!

Regards,
Kalyan
